This year I will plant rice on my main plot like I always do here in Ruvuma. The rains come well enough, so I do not need to irrigate — I rely on the rainfall as my neighbors do. I will buy one bag of urea if I can manage, and spread some manure from the animals around the homestead, but I keep my own seed from last season because the improved seed from town costs too much for me. For the transplanting and the weeding I will call a few people to help me, but most of the work I do myself with my family.
